title: Ramen So Good, It's to Die For
notes: Recurring detective-cast nodes (Conan, Kogoro Mouri, Ran, Inspector Megure, Takagi) omitted by convention. No `event` node type: every action is a directly typed edge between the entities involved (person/location/object). Old low-fidelity case file (cases/ep644-645_ramen_so_good_its_to_die_for.json) already had the correct culprit (Taninaka) and the broad shape of the poisoning trick, so no culprit-identity correction was needed here -- but two details were refined against the full transcript: (1) the old file's clue c2 said the victim's own glasses were 'missing/swapped', which is imprecise -- the victim's actual glasses were recovered and tested clean; what was hidden was that Taninaka had swapped his own identical, seldom-worn reading glasses onto the victim's body after the collapse, retrieving the poisoned original pair for himself, so the trick is a two-pair swap rather than a disappearance. (2) The old file omitted the backstory victim (Sayo's father, a deceased attorney) entirely, along with Taninaka's real dual motive (retaliation for Saizu's extortion racket against his barbershop, plus a long-simmering wish to force Ramen Ogura to remodel or close as part of the shopping street's 20-year redevelopment pact) and Sayo's independent revenge motive -- both now represented as separate `has_motive_against` edges per the red-herring rule. case_type: murder.

clues.desc: Poison was concentrated on the victim's left thumb and index finger, with only dilute trace amounts on the chopsticks and table and none at all in the ramen, water, or flowers -- the distribution fits hand-to-mouth transfer, not food contamination.

Forced to put on his glasses left-handed like Saizu did, Taninaka avoided gripping the temple/frame joint; those same glasses then tested positive for poison, while the pair recovered from the victim's body had already tested clean.

edges.method: cyanide-laced glasses frame; poison transferred to fingers when the victim removed his fogged glasses, then to chopsticks and lips, then ingested while eating ramen

edges.detail: intended the poisoning to happen inside Ramen Ogura so no customer would return, forcing it to remodel or close
sent employees to pick fights and break tableware, then demanded compensation
sent employees to get shaved and deliberately flinch so their cheeks got cut, then demanded medical bills
one of Saizu's men started a fight in Ramen Ogura; the attorney was dragged in trying to stop it and suffered a fatal cerebral hemorrhage
was preparing the shopping street's lawsuit over Saizu's harassment when he died; the suit was dropped
